description: This file defines classes and functions for GPU delegate API in TensorFlow Lite, specifically for the OpenGL backend. It declares interfaces for compiled models, inference contexts, and related operations used to run GPU-accelerated inference on TensorFlow Lite models, including serialization and resource management.

classes.name: CompiledModel
classes.description: Abstract interface representing a GPU-compiled model, capable of creating inference contexts and providing compilation statistics.

classes.name: InferenceContext
classes.description: Interface for managing inference execution, including running inference, retrieving stats, and resetting the context.

methods.name: stats
methods.description: Returns statistics about the compiled model or inference context.

methods.name: NewRun
methods.description: Creates a new inference context for executing the model, using specified runtime options and command queue.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the compiled model into a byte array for storage or transfer.

methods.name: ReadSerializedModel
methods.description: Deserializes a stored model from a byte array back into a compiled model.

methods.name: Execute
methods.description: Runs the inference associated with the current inference context.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Prepares the inference context for subsequent runs without reinitializing resources.
